_: A word on hover over the map's things (map_tip.gd; Total War's and CK3's map tooltips, in the realm's words): a town or a host under the cursor, from further out than faces are seen (folk_tip.gd has people and the land's scars). every: seconds between looks; town_reach, host_reach: how near the cursor (game units) a town or host counts; words: what each part says ({house}, {n}, {to}; {work}: the King's works in the town; lord_risk ({slain}, {taken}): what a house's lord risks if its host going in is beaten, from bridge /world fate).

words.closed: the plague is here, its roads shut
words.lord_risk: if beaten, its lord: {slain} in 100 falls, {taken} in 100 is taken
